correctness.rationale: The proof identifies every finite singular block by an explicit orthogonal radial/contrast decomposition and checks completeness by a dimension identity. After output index reversal, every fixed trailing block converges in Hilbert--Schmidt norm to an explicit rank-one operator by a square-summable geometric majorant; compression monotonicity separates the remaining deep blocks. Thus all fixed-rank limiting singular values, branch multiplicities, the top norm and gap follow without numerical extrapolation. Direct independent matrix calculations agree for small trees (133 finite assertions), but are not invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Ancestor Cesàro averaging is a natural and motivated path-mean operator on a complete regular tree. The theorem supplies the complete fixed-rank optimal Hilbert approximation profile with sharp constants and exact branching multiplicities, showing a geometric staircase not exposed by order-of-magnitude entropy or norm estimates. This gives quantitative low-rank compression information with an intrinsic branch interpretation, beyond an elementary isolated finite computation.
